name: private-function-history
goal: Explicit removal-commit addresses retain private functions last active contracts without adding them to shared collections

evidence: At an explicit removal commit, the retained private function address must show its last active parent contract and Removed at this commit. Private functions remain excluded from shared catalogs. The hosted lifecycle scenario currently renders Not at this revision.

Existing unit coverage tests public removals and active private ownership separately. Extend the existing entity-frame render suite across retired tombstones and fully absent head entries, asserting parent contract, removed verdict, catalog exclusion, missing-parent and unrelated-revision guards. The unchanged hosted catalog private lifecycle scenario independently reproduces the same failure.
